title: Probing Association Biases in LLM Moderation Over-Sensitivity

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to generate open-ended imagined scenarios for misclassified benign comments and calculating the embedding-based semantic relevance (Topic Amplification Index) between the text and 17 scenario-prominent topics (e.g., media, conspiracy, healthcare).

Measuring the topic amplification index and over-sensitivity contrast for political keywords (e.g., 'democrats', 'republicans', 'politics') in LLM-imagined scenarios linked to false-positive toxicity judgments.
Calculating the semantic relevance gap and topic amplification index for racial keywords (e.g., 'white', 'black', 'asian', 'hispanic') within the scenarios LLMs generate when over-flagging content.
Analyzing the topic amplification index for gender-related keywords (e.g., 'men', 'women') in LLM-generated background scenarios for non-toxic comments misclassified as toxic.
